intro: One medium apple has about 90 kcal. Almost all the calories come from natural sugar, and it's quite high in fibre.
diet: Yes, apples are one of the most diet-friendly snacks. The fibre keeps you full, and you need to chew a lot, so you don't finish it too fast. A whole apple is better than juice. Juice loses the fibre and it's easy to drink a lot in one go.
tips: Eat it with the skin on for more fibre.
Bring an apple to the office as a tea-time snack instead of kuih.
Go for the whole fruit, not boxed apple juice.

swap.name: 1 medium jambu batu (guava)
swap.why: Fewer calories, more fibre and vitamin C. Easy to find at the pasar and fruit stalls.

faq.q: Green or red apple, which is better?
faq.a: Both are good. Green apples are a bit less sweet, but the calorie difference is very small. Pick the one you like.

faq.q: Do I need to peel the apple?
faq.a: No need. The skin has a lot of fibre. Just wash it well under running water first.

faq.q: How do I stop cut apples from turning brown?
faq.a: Squeeze a little limau nipis on it, or soak it briefly in lightly salted water. Keep it in a covered container.
